_comment: Quantaureum Bridge — TESTNET configuration template (P3-5). Copy this file to configs/config.json and fill in the values. ChainID: 1669. Testnet uses independent validator keys, completely isolated from mainnet. SECURITY: Do NOT reuse mainnet keys on testnet.
_usage: 1) Copy to configs/config.json. 2) Set QAU_ENABLE_BRIDGE=1 env var. 3) Fill in bridgeContractAddresses and nodeUrls. 4) Set initializerAddress to the testnet governance address. 5) Set validatorPublicKeyHex and relayerPublicKeyHex from testnet validator keys. 6) Start the node.
_securityNotes: Testnet validator keys MUST be independent from mainnet keys.
bootstrapMode may be set to true during initial testnet setup, but disable after registering signatures.
Old mainnet validator keys must be completely removed from testnet servers.
DevMode must be disabled to prevent signature verification bypass.
